# Comment Memory Implementation Agent

Implement support for a new memory type called `comment-memory` in the GitHub Agentic Workflows framework.

## Objective

Add `comment-memory` as a first-class memory backend that persists structured memory in a GitHub comment attached to an issue or pull request, and updates that comment across workflow runs.

## Existing Memory Backends

- `cache-memory` (GitHub Actions cache)
- `repo-memory` (repository storage)

## Functional Requirements

- Add support for frontmatter field: `comment-memory`
- Support one or more memories (named and unnamed)
- Resolve execution context automatically (issue or pull request)
- Create memory comment on first run
- Update existing memory comment on subsequent runs
- Store memory using XML markers for robust parsing and identification
- Expose comment-memory to the agent as a writable markdown file abstraction

## Authentication Requirements

- Support default GitHub token
- Support custom GitHub token
- Support GitHub App authentication
- Support targeting external repositories when configured

## Detection and Validation Requirements

- Detect and validate `comment-memory` configuration in frontmatter
- Require issue/PR-compatible context
- Reject unsupported contexts (for example discussion-only contexts)
- Fail early when configuration or context requirements are not met

## Sanitization and Size Requirements

- Apply standard body sanitization rules
- Enforce GitHub comment size limits
- Reserve body space for:
  - XML tracking markers
  - AI-generated footer

## Formatting Requirements

Comment content must be markdown and include:

- XML tracking markers for parsing
- Clear human-readable delimiters
- `Generated by AI` footer

## Execution Plan

### Phase 0: Setup

- Identify existing memory abstractions (`cache-memory`, `repo-memory`)
- Locate frontmatter parsing and schema validation
- Locate detection/validation pipeline
- Locate comment create/update utilities and comment formatting helpers

### Phase 1: Frontmatter and Schema Extension

- Add `comment-memory` field to schema/frontmatter support
- Support single and multi-entry configurations
- Define deterministic default identifier when name is omitted

### Phase 2: Detection and Validation

- Extend detection/validation to parse `comment-memory`
- Validate execution context is issue/PR-compatible
- Validate authentication and repository targeting configuration
- Return actionable validation errors

Pseudo-logic:

```text
IF comment-memory defined THEN
  IF context NOT issue AND NOT pull_request THEN
    FAIL validation
  END IF
END IF
```

### Phase 3: Memory Resolution and Identification

At workflow start:

- Search for existing comment-memory comment using XML markers
- Match by explicit memory name when present
- Match by default identifier when name is omitted
- If no match, create a new memory comment

### Phase 4: Comment Lifecycle Management

- First run: create comment with initialized markdown section
- Subsequent runs: update only the managed memory section
- Preserve marker integrity and readable formatting
- Ensure AI footer remains present and consistent

## Deliverables

- Implementation code for `comment-memory`
- Tests covering parsing, validation, context handling, and lifecycle behavior
- Prompt/runtime integration so the agent can read/write comment-memory via markdown abstraction
- Updated workflow schema/frontmatter support
- Pull request with a clear summary, implementation notes, and test evidence
